package.description: An open compatibility testing network for developer libraries and runtimes

en-US.description: An open compatibility testing network for developer libraries and runtimes
en-US.longDescription: CodeSampleX is an open compatibility testing network for developer libraries, runtimes, and toolchains. It records what real builds actually did in recorded environments, answering whether an API runs on your version, OS, and runtime with real build evidence and verified contracts.
en-US.name: CodeSampleX
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
- Preserve unknown observation failures and classify confirmed budgets by @r2cuerdame in #572
- Propagate confirmed observer budgets through failure and final-wait paths by @r2cuerdame in #573
- Correlate author child exit and draft acceptance with bounded receipts by @r2cuerdame in #574
